scheme_name: Hita-dhikaari Ke Samanye Athava Durghatana Me Mrityu Ya Ghayal Hone Ki Dasha Me Sahayata Yojana
description:
Hita-dhikaari Ke Samanye Athava Durghatana Me Mrityu Ya Ghayal Hone Ki Dasha Me Sahayata Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. 

This scheme was launched on 1st January 2021. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the families of individuals who have died or sustained injuries due to accidents. 

The scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden on families who face sudden loss or medical expenses due to such unfortunate incidents. 

The government has set a target to assist at least 10,000 families annually under this scheme. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is structured as follows. 

In the event of death due to an accident, the family of the deceased is entitled to receive a compensation of INR 4 lakh. 

If an individual sustains serious injuries due to an accident, the scheme provides for medical assistance of up to INR 2 lakh. 

This financial assistance aims to cover medical expenses and provide support for the family during a difficult time. 

Eligibility for this scheme is defined clearly. 

The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 

The deceased or injured individual must have been engaged in a legal activity at the time of the accident. 

There are no specific age limits for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, the income of the family should not exceed INR 2 lakh per annum. 

The application process for the scheme is straightforward. 

Interested applicants must visit the official website of the Madhya Pradesh government. 

They can also approach the local revenue office or the district collectorate for assistance. 

The required documents include a copy of the death certificate or medical report of the injured individual. 

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of residence and income certificate. 

An application form must be filled out, which is available at local government offices or online. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The timeline for processing applications is typically within 30 days from the date of submission. 

Disbursement of financial assistance is made directly to the bank account of the eligible beneficiaries. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Revenue, Government of Madhya Pradesh. 

For any inquiries or assistance, individuals can contact the Department of Revenue at their official helpline number. 

The helpline number is available on the official Madhya Pradesh government website. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Madhya Pradesh government to enhance social security for its residents. 

In the fiscal year 2021-2022, the government allocated INR 50 crore for this scheme. 

This allocation reflects the government's commitment to providing timely support to families affected by accidents. 

The scheme also aims to raise awareness about road safety and accident prevention. 

Workshops and campaigns are organized to educate the public about safety measures. 

The government collaborates with local NGOs and community organizations to promote these initiatives. 

Statistical data indicates that road accidents have been a significant cause of fatalities in Madhya Pradesh. 

According to the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, Madhya Pradesh recorded over 40,000 road accidents in 2020. 

This alarming statistic underscores the need for such welfare schemes. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries who have availed of the assistance. 

Many families have expressed gratitude for the timely support during their time of need. 

The government regularly reviews the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and reach. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The scheme is part of a larger framework of social welfare initiatives in Madhya Pradesh. 

Other related schemes include health insurance programs and financial aid for education. 

The government aims to create a comprehensive safety net for its citizens. 

The success of the Hita-dhikaari Ke Samanye Athava Durghatana Me Mrityu Ya Ghayal Hone Ki Dasha Me Sahayata Yojana is monitored through various metrics. 

These include the number of applications received and the amount of assistance disbursed. 

Regular reports are published to keep the public informed about the scheme's progress. 

The government encourages eligible individuals to take advantage of this scheme. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted to ensure that the public is informed about the benefits available. 

In conclusion, the Hita-dhikaari Ke Samanye Athava Durghatana Me Mrityu Ya Ghayal Hone Ki Dasha Me Sahayata Yojana serves as a crucial support system for families affected by accidents. 

By providing financial assistance, the scheme aims to reduce the economic impact of such tragedies. 

The Madhya Pradesh government remains committed to enhancing the welfare of its citizens through such initiatives. 

Overall, this scheme represents a significant step towards ensuring social security and support for vulnerable families in the state.
